summary: Great size student house · Great Jesmond location · Available September 2024 · 10 month tenancy
description:
A stylish four bedroom student house in an excellent Jesmond location.

My Property Box welcome to the Student Lettings market this four bedroom house at Fenwick Close, Jesmond.

Nestled away in a quiet corner of Jesmond close to Buston Terrace, the house is ideal for a group who desire large open plan communal areas with four good sized bedrooms. There are also front & back gardens as well as off-street parking. Close proximity to Osborne Road, Waitrose and Rehills. 20 minute walking commute to both university campuses. More photos to follow.

Available to a group of four from September on a 10 month tenancy. Furnished.

To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
